cards.title: Defaults
cards.body: Give a parameter a default with `=`. When the caller leaves it out, the default is used.

hi.title: Defaults
hi.body: Parameter ko `=` se default do. Agar call karne wala use chhod de, toh default use hota hai.

cards.title: Returning text
cards.body: A function can build a string, often between backticks, and return it.

hi.title: Text return karna
hi.body: Function ek string bana sakta hai, aksar backticks ke beech, aur use return kar sakta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `pen costs 25`, but prints `25 costs pen`. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Arguments fill the parameters in order, and `item` comes first. Call it as `price("pen", 25)`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse `pen costs 25` print karna chahiye, par yeh `25 costs pen` print karta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Arguments parameters ko order mein bharte hain, aur `item` pehle aata hai. Call aise karo: `price("pen", 25)`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The call passes "!", so it replaces the default "*".

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Call "!" bhejta hai, isliye woh default "*" ki jagah le leta hai.

exercise.prompt: Finish `greet(name, greeting = "Hello")` so it returns `<greeting>, <name>!`. The code below prints `greet(name)` and then `greet(name, "Welcome")`.
exercise.promptHi: `greet(name, greeting = "Hello")` poora karo taaki woh `<greeting>, <name>!` return kare. Neeche ka code `greet(name)` aur phir `greet(name, "Welcome")` print karta hai.

hiddenTests.expectedOutput:
Hello, Mary Jane!
Welcome, Mary Jane!
